title: [MCP] Hide codeunit APIs from Available APIs dropdown (AB#650771)
summary: Codeunit API options are hidden from the MCP Configuration Available APIs dropdown until platform compiler support is ready, while all underlying validation and helper code remains intact for future re-enablement.
key_points: Codeunit choices removed from MCP Config Tool List Available APIs lookup
Page and Query lookup behavior unchanged
All validation, tool creation, and version logic preserved for future use
Temporary hiding pending platform compiler support
No breaking changes to persisted data or upgrade behavior
quote: This removes Codeunit choices from the MCP Configuration Available APIs lookup to avoid presenting customers with options that cannot yet be used.
